title: Regex Studio
description: A from-scratch regex workbench. NEWEST — PRESBURGER ARITHMETIC ⇒ AUTOMATON, number theory as a machine: the Logic tab compiled a STRING logic (MSO[<]) into an automaton over word positions; this new PRESBURGER tab compiles NUMBER THEORY. By BÜCHI–BRUYÈRE–VILLEMAIRE the first-order theory of ⟨ℕ,+,<⟩ (with congruences t≡r (mod m)) is decidable because every formula translates to a finite automaton over the BINARY DIGITS of its variables — one track per variable, read least-significant-digit first, accepting exactly the base-2 encodings of the satisfying tuples. Type a linear-arithmetic formula (terms 2*x+3*y−1, atoms = < <= > >= != and congruences, connectives ~ & | -> <->, quantifiers exists/forall over ℕ) and watch the automaton get BUILT by structural recursion: an ATOM Σaᵢxᵢ=c is the CARRY AUTOMATON (state = the residual target, halved each digit; the reachable states stay bounded by Σ|aᵢ|), an inequality the same with a floor and accept-at-≥0, a congruence the (value mod m, 2ʲ mod m) residue machine; ∧ = product, ∨ = union, ¬ = COMPLEMENT (a plain flip — every bit-string is a valid natural-number encoding, so unlike MSO there is NO validity language to intersect), and ∃x = PROJECT the digit track away, re-determinise, and 0-SATURATE to close the language under leading-zero padding (∀ = ¬∃¬). x+y=z is literally a TWO-STATE RIPPLE-CARRY ADDER (the states are carry / no-carry); '∃y. x=y+y' projects to the classic 'binary even' automaton and is proved language-equal to the congruence x≡0 (mod 2); '∃a∃b. n=3a+5b' reads the CHICKEN-McNUGGET solution set straight off the machine with the Frobenius gap at 7 visible; a SENTENCE (no free variables) collapses to a single TRUE/FALSE decided by the automaton's non-emptiness, so ∀x∃y.x<y comes back TRUE and ∃x∃y.2x=2y+1 comes back FALSE (even can never equal odd — the projected automaton is empty). The tab shows the digit automaton as a pan/zoom graph (edges labelled with each variable's current bit, DOT/SVG export), the sentence verdict, the SOLUTION SET decoded straight back from the automaton, a tuple grid confronting the automaton against the exact arithmetic oracle, the per-subformula construction trace, and a seeded proof console that checks the compiler FOUR exact ways — the quantifier-free automaton matches the oracle on every tuple in a box, ∀x.φ and ¬∃x¬φ compile to the SAME language, every oracle witness is accepted by the projected ∃x.φ, and a battery of textbook Presburger identities holds — 50,000+ exact checks per seed at zero disagreements. This is the ARITHMETIC pillar of AUTOMATIC STRUCTURES beside the studio's MSO string logic — Presburger's 1929 decidability result made something you can watch get built. PREVIOUSLY — A PATTERN GOES IN, A LINEAR ALTERNATING AUTOMATON COMES OUT, AND IT IS DECIDED ON THE SPOT: the Alternation tab could only ever be WRITTEN by hand; now type an extended regex (with & intersection and ~ complement) and watch it compile to an AFA that is LINEAR in the pattern — a plain subexpression becomes its ANTIMIROV PARTIAL-DERIVATIVE states (≤ #letters+1), and the two operators that force a determinisation everywhere else in the studio are FREE here: a&b is a ∧ JOIN over the disjoint union (no product) and ~a is the DUAL (no complete-then-flip), so '~(.*aa.*) & .*b.*' — no 'aa' AND has a 'b' — is a 5-state AFA the studio determinises beside you to show the DFA it saved, and '.*a..' (the 3rd symbol from the end is a) is 4 alternating states blowing up to the 8-state min-DFA. A minimal FAITHFUL ALPHABET is inferred (Σ collapsed to the coarsest set that still tells every branch apart — one symbol standing for 'any other character'), and the whole thing is DECIDED WITHOUT DETERMINISING: EMPTINESS by an ANTICHAIN search straight on the AFA over ⊆-minimal macrostates (L(S)=⋂L(q) is antitone in S, so a macrostate subsumed by a retained smaller one is dropped; the shortest path to an accepting S⊆F is a witness word) expanding a handful where a determiniser walks thousands, and UNIVERSALITY FOR FREE because complement is — L=Σ* iff L(~A)=∅, so universality is emptiness of the dual, a rejected word falling out as the dual's witness. An ANIMATED ALTERNATING RUN TREE reads a word and branches — an ∧-node demanding ALL its children accept the suffix, an ∨-node demanding ONE, each coloured by satisfaction. Proved the house way against THREE independent authorities on every word up to a horizon: ereg's span oracle (ends(A&B)=ends A ∩ ends B, ends(~A)=complement), the AFA→NFA→DFA→min pipeline, and the determinised DFA's own emptiness/universality (which the antichain deciders must match, witness for witness) — ~350,000 checks across seeds at zero disagreements. PREVIOUSLY — ALTERNATION, THE AUTOMATON THAT BRANCHES ∧ AND ∨ AT ONCE: a DFA has one successor; an NFA accepts if SOME run does (existential ∨); a co-NFA if EVERY run does (universal ∧); an ALTERNATING finite automaton does both — each transition δ(q,a) is an arbitrary POSITIVE BOOLEAN FORMULA over the states (Chandra–Kozen–Stockmeyer) — and yet recognises exactly the regular languages. A new ALTERNATION tab lets you WRITE one in a tiny textual format (alphabet / init formula / state,symbol -> formula / final) and pays off the two things alternation buys. COMPLEMENT IS FREE AND LINEAR: dualise every formula (∧↔∨) and flip the final set and the SAME states accept the negation — where an NFA must determinise to complement. INTERSECTION and UNION ARE LINEAR: just ∧/∨ the two initial formulas over the disjoint union, no product. The price is paid only on DETERMINISATION — n alternating states become up to 2ⁿ NFA MACROSTATES, a set of states that must ALL accept the rest of the word (the ∧-reading, whose successors are the minimal models of the conjunction ⋀δ), which the studio's own subset construction + minimiser then reduce: so 'length divisible by 2 AND 3 AND 5' is 10 alternating states (three independent modular counters under one ∧) that blow up to the lcm-30 minimal DFA — sum beats product — while 'the 3rd symbol from the end is a' is a 4-state existential guess whose minimal DFA needs 2³. The determinised machine is a first-class studio citizen — it flows into Compare, Census, the syntactic monoid and DFA→regex, so the tab reads the AFA's language back as a REGULAR EXPRESSION by state-elimination. Proved the house way: the brute-force alternating semantics (δ recursed down the word, ∧/∨-folded, bottoming out at the final set) is the oracle, and a seeded fuzzer draws random alternating automata and confronts every AFA→NFA→DFA→min construction against it on EVERY word up to a horizon — the pipeline must accept exactly the oracle's language, the DUAL must accept its complement, and the ∧/∨ combination of two AFAs must accept their intersection/union — 250,000+ differential, complement and closure checks across seeds at zero disagreements. The tab shows the alternating transition table δ:Q×Σ→B⁺(Q), live stats with the determinisation blow-up factor, the language read back as a regex, an OBLIGATION-FRONTIER run of any word (which states must accept each suffix), one-click complement / intersect / union, the minimal DFA graph and the seeded cross-check console. PREVIOUSLY — TRANSDUCERS, MACHINES THAT TRANSLATE NOT JUST ACCEPT: every prior tab computes a LANGUAGE — it says yes or no to a word; this one is the studio's first RELATION machine — a FINITE-STATE TRANSDUCER, which reads an input word and EMITS output words, its edges labelled read:write, computing a relation R ⊆ Σ*×Γ* (a FUNCTION on words when single-valued) — the model behind tokenisers, spell-checkers, transliteration and phonology. A new TRANSDUCERS tab ships a gallery spanning every phenomenon the theory cares about: ROT13 (a Mealy involution), a↔b swap, BINARY INCREMENT (LSB-first — a genuine subsequential machine with a carry state and an overflow bit flushed as the FINAL OUTPUT), delete-x (ε-output, the output shorter than the input), double-every-symbol (multi-symbol writes), a running-index-mod-3 Mealy machine whose output depends on the STATE not the symbol, optional-double (genuinely NON-FUNCTIONAL — one input, a whole SET of outputs, which is why a transducer computes a relation), and DELAYED-CHOICE aⁿb→xⁿ, aⁿc→yⁿ (functional yet NOT subsequentialisable — the textbook twinning-failure witness). Pick one and WATCH IT TRANSLATE on an animated tape — input consumed left-to-right, output emitted below, the final output flushed with ⇥, the current state lit on the read:write graph. The RATIONAL RELATIONS are exactly what finite transducers compute, and (ELGOT–MEZEI) they are closed under UNION, CONCATENATION, STAR and COMPOSITION — all built from scratch: union/concat/star are the transducer twins of Thompson's ε-NFA constructions, and COMPOSE(A,B) is the deep one, feeding A's output straight into B's input to make one machine for the whole pipeline {(x,z):∃y,(x,y)∈A ∧ (y,z)∈B} — the COMPOSE playground watches x→A(x)→(A;B)(x) and collapses ROT13∘ROT13 to the identity. DETERMINISATION → SUBSEQUENTIAL is the centrepiece: the transducer analogue of subset construction, where a deterministic state is a set of (state, PENDING-OUTPUT) pairs and each step emits the LONGEST COMMON PREFIX of the pending outputs and carries the remainder forward; it works iff the machine has CHOFFRUT's TWINNING PROPERTY, and when the residuals grow without bound the panel DETECTS the failure and reports the function is not subsequentialisable rather than looping — so delayed-choice is exposed live. A BRIDGE ties it back to the whole studio: the regex you typed becomes the IDENTITY TRANSDUCTION (echo the word iff it is in L). Proved the house way: a seeded differential fuzzer draws random transducers and confronts EVERY construction against a brute-force reference computed straight from the relation semantics — union/concat/star match the reference relation over all splits and partitions, composition equals running A then B by hand over every input, determinisation of a functional machine computes the same function and is deterministic (and delayed-choice is correctly rejected), and identity(L) echoes exactly a compiled regex's language — ~449,000 checks across 6 seeds at zero disagreements (it surfaced and fixed two real bugs during the build: a star loop-back that returned to a.start instead of the accepting start, and a brute-star reference that wrongly allowed the empty partition on a non-empty word). PREVIOUSLY — TWO-WAY DFA, THE HEAD TURNS AROUND: every prior road scans the input ONCE, left to right; this one lets the head move BOTH ways over a tape framed by end-markers ⊢ w ⊣, re-reading the word as often as it likes. By the RABIN–SCOTT / SHEPHERDSON theorem that buys NO extra power — every two-way DFA recognises a regular language — and the witness is a construction you can watch. A new 2-WAY DFA tab compiles a 2DFA to an equivalent one-way DFA by SHEPHERDSON's TRANSITION-PROFILE (crossing-sequence) method: the one-way machine reads w once and its state is the BEHAVIOUR TABLE of the prefix so far — the finite summary of everything the two-way head could do confined to that prefix (for each state it might re-enter the prefix in, where it comes back out, or whether it loops), so two prefixes with the same table are MYHILL–NERODE indistinguishable and the table set is finite. Reading a symbol advances both the table and the real run's crossing state through one primitive; acceptance asks what happens if ⊣ comes now; absorbing outcomes collapse to a shared accept sink or the dead sink — and the result is a real DFA that flows straight into the studio's DFA / Language / Compare machinery. The tab ships a gallery of hand-built two-way machines (first = last character by an out-and-back sweep; even-a-even-b by TWO passes with a full leftward rewind; the cell just left of the last b, found with two reversals), ANIMATES the head bouncing over a test string with its live state on a tape, reads off the CROSSING SEQUENCE at every boundary, and shows the constructed one-way DFA beside a 2DFA/DFA/minimal-DFA state-count comparison (folding passes into one direction trades states either way — a 2DFA can be exponentially more succinct than any DFA). A ROUND TRIP lifts the studio's current pattern DFA into a right-only 2DFA and pushes it back through the construction, with compareDFAs proving the language unchanged — the easy half of Rabin–Scott (a DFA is a 2DFA that never turns) meeting the hard half on one machine. Proved the house way: a seeded fuzzer draws random two-way DFAs and confronts the constructed DFA with a TRIVIALLY-CORRECT ORACLE — the real two-way head run with EXACT loop detection (a deterministic 2DFA either halts or repeats a configuration) — on random words, round-trips every machine, and re-checks the whole gallery EXHAUSTIVELY over every word up to a horizon; 228,000+ differential + round-trip + gallery checks across 8 seeds, zero disagreements. The tab also makes the SUCCINCTNESS gap concrete with the Sakoda–Sipser witness 'the n-th symbol from the right is a': a 2DFA sweeps to ⊣ and walks back n cells in n+3 states, while the minimal one-way DFA needs 2ⁿ states — slide n and watch the constructed DFA blow up exponentially while the 2DFA grows by one. PREVIOUSLY — WEIGHTED AUTOMATA, ONE MACHINE × EVERY SEMIRING: every prior tab asks whether an accepting run EXISTS (the Boolean world); this one asks what a run is WORTH. A new WEIGHTED tab puts a weight κ from a chosen SEMIRING on each state of the studio's ε-free Glushkov position automaton, so a word's weight is the ⊕-sum, over its accepting runs, of the ⊗-product along each — Schützenberger's RATIONAL POWER SERIES and Mohri's generic semiring framework, lowered onto the studio's own machine. Swap the semiring and the SAME automaton computes a different thing: BOOLEAN (∨,∧) is plain recognition (≡ the DFA); COUNTING (+,×) on ℕ∪∞ is the number of accepting runs — literally the AMBIGUITY DEGREE the Ambiguity tab measures, so (a|a)(b|b) weighs 4 on 'ab' and eliminates to the regex ab+ab+ab+ab; TROPICAL (min,+) is the cheapest run — Mohri's SHORTEST DISTANCE / best parse; VITERBI (max,×) is the single most-likely run, an HMM's MAP path; PROBABILITY (+,×) is the total mass over runs. A word's weight is computed THREE independent ways that must agree — the FORWARD vector–matrix sweep λ·μ(a₁)…μ(aₙ)·γ, a transposed BACKWARD sweep, and a brute enumeration of every accepting run. The ALL-WORDS CLOSURE ⊕_w weight(w) = λ·M*·γ (the total path count, the shortest distance, the language mass — Mohri's algebraic path problem) is computed by LEHMANN's closed-form matrix asteration and CROSS-CHECKED by eliminating the automaton's states back into a WEIGHTED REGULAR EXPRESSION (Kleene's theorem graded by a semiring — the weighted generalisation of the DFA→regex tab) and re-evaluating it under the a↦1̄ augmentation, plus an iterative ⊕Mᵏ and a brute Σ*-sum on finite languages. Proved the house way: a seeded fuzzer over random patterns × all five semirings × weightings × words confirms forward≡backward≡brute per word, that the Boolean weight ≡ the DFA's verdict and the Counting weight ≡ the Ambiguity tab's run count, that the four closure roads agree, and that the semiring laws (left-distributivity, the star fixpoint a*=1̄⊕a·a*) hold — 1,180,000+ differential checks across 24 seeds, zero disagreements (it surfaced and fixed a real Lehmann double-star bug, an IEEE ∞·0 NaN, and a parity-gap convergence trap along the way). The tab shows the weighted automaton as a pan/zoom graph (edges labelled class/κ, DOT/SVG export), a word's weight with the per-semiring meaning and the brute-agreement badge, the per-state weights κ, the all-words closure beside the eliminated weighted regex, a gallery of readings, and the seeded cross-check console. PREVIOUSLY — Ω / BÜCHI, CROSSING INTO THE INFINITE: the whole studio lived on FINITE words; this crosses into the ω-REGULAR world — infinite traces, liveness, the automata-theoretic approach to model checking (Vardi–Wolper). A new ω / Büchi tab takes a LINEAR-TEMPORAL-LOGIC spec over infinite traces (X next, F eventually, G globally, U until, R release, W weak-until, M strong-release, with ~ & | -> <->; a proposition is a letter of Σ) and BUILDS the Büchi automaton it denotes by the classic GERTH–PELED–VARDI–WOLPER (1995) on-the-fly tableau: the formula is pushed to negation-normal form, the tableau's recursive expand splits ∨/U/R into now-versus-later obligations (the New/Old/Next fields), and one accepting set is emitted per Until-subformula (its eventuality — a run may not promise φUψ forever without ever delivering ψ); that GENERALIZED Büchi automaton is then DEGENERALIZED to a plain NBA by the Baier–Katoen counter construction. Decision is the only thing ω-words allow — a REACHABLE ACCEPTING CYCLE, found by Tarjan SCCs, whose witness is a LASSO u·(v)ᵒ (read the stem once, repeat the loop forever; the accepting state on the loop is visited infinitely often). From that fall the two questions the automata-theoretic approach reduces everything to: SATISFIABILITY (L(NBA(φ)) is non-empty, with a model lasso) and VALIDITY (L(NBA(¬φ)) is empty, else a counterexample lasso) — so G F a (infinitely often) and F G a (eventually always) are the two canonical Büchi shapes, G(a->F b) is request–response liveness, and G a & F ¬a comes back UNSATISFIABLE with an empty automaton. This is the INFINITE-WORD SIBLING of the Logic tab: LTL = FO[<] on infinite traces (Kamp) and ω-regular = S1S (Büchi), the studio's MSO theorem one level up. Proved the house way: a brute-force LTL semantics on ultimately-periodic words (every temporal operator a least/greatest fixpoint over the lasso's finitely many position-classes) is the independent oracle, and a seeded fuzzer confirms across 420,000+ checks over random LTL formulas and lassos (offline) that the automaton accepts EXACTLY the oracle's words AND that for every lasso EXACTLY ONE of NBA(φ), NBA(¬φ) accepts — the two ω-languages partition Σᵒ, a live test of Büchi complementation, zero disagreements. The tab shows the generalized and degeneralized Büchi automata as pan/zoom graphs (DOT/SVG export, ι marks the initial states), the sat/valid verdict with the lasso witness ANIMATED step-by-step on the graph, a truth table (oracle vs NBA over sampled lassos), the closure->GBA->NBA construction trace, and the seeded cross-check. PREVIOUSLY — AMBIGUITY & MULTIPLICITY: Census counts WORDS, this counts RUNS — for one input, how many distinct accepting paths does the NFA have? That degree of ambiguity falls, by the WEBER–SEIDL theorem, into exactly four classes decided structurally on the ε-free Glushkov automaton: UNAMBIGUOUS (≤1 run; the squared automaton N×N has no useful off-diagonal pair) ⊂ FINITELY ambiguous (a constant cap) ⊂ POLYNOMIALLY ambiguous of a precise integer degree d (runs ~ nᵈ) ⊂ EXPONENTIALLY ambiguous (runs ~ 2ⁿ). The two combinatorial witnesses are built from scratch: EDA (exponential) is a state with TWO distinct same-word cycles, found as an SCC of the squared automaton touching both the diagonal (q,q) and an off-diagonal (a,b≠a) — exactly the ReDoS exponential condition, now read off Glushkov and tied back to that tab; IDA (polynomial) is a path (p,p,q) ⇝ (p,q,q) in the CUBED automaton N×N×N, and the degree is the longest IDA-chain of states. The tab shows the verdict, a word matched two ways (the two position-paths with the divergence lit), the EDA pump growing the run count 2ᵏ, the Glushkov graph with the witness states highlighted, and a RUNS-vs-WORDS table whose gap IS the ambiguity (runs = words ⇔ unambiguous). Proved the house way: the total run count Rₙ is pinned to an exact integer transfer matrix e₀ᵀBⁿf and cross-checked against a brute-force enumeration over the pattern's symbol atoms, every ambiguity/EDA witness is re-confirmed to genuinely multiply runs, and a seeded fuzzer verified zero disagreements across thousands of random patterns (offline). PREVIOUSLY — LOGIC ⇒ AUTOMATON, the converse of the whole studio: every other tab compiles a regex DOWN to an automaton, and the Algebra tab then classifies the language by which LOGIC defines it (FO[<], FO², MSO). A new LOGIC tab runs the other direction — the BÜCHI–ELGOT–TRAKHTENBROT theorem: a language is regular IFF it is defined by a sentence of monadic second-order logic MSO[<] over word positions. You write a formula (atoms Qa(x), x<y, x=y, S(x,y) successor, x in X; connectives ~ & | -> <->; first-order quantifiers exists x / forall x over positions and SECOND-ORDER exists X / forall X over sets of positions) and the automaton gets BUILT by structural recursion over the product alphabet Σ×{0,1}^(free vars): each atom a tiny hand-made DFA (FO atoms enforcing their variables are singletons), ∧ = product, ∨ = union, ¬ = complement-WITHIN-THE-VALID-ENCODINGS, exists = project the variable's bit-track away then re-determinise (∀ = ¬∃¬). A sentence leaves an automaton over just Σ — lowered into the studio's own DFA and minimised, so it flows unchanged into Min-DFA, Language, Census and the Algebra views. That closes the loop with sessions 8–9: by McNAUGHTON–PAPERT a FIRST-ORDER formula must compile to a STAR-FREE language, and the panel proves it LIVE by running the result through the studio's syntactic-monoid engine (aperiodic ✓) — while a genuinely second-order formula like EVEN LENGTH comes back NOT star-free, named the group ℤ/2, so FO ⊊ MSO is shown, not asserted. An LTLf mode parses linear temporal logic on finite traces (X next, F eventually, G globally, U until, R release) and DESUGARS it to FO[<] with one 'now' variable (Kamp's theorem), so a temporal spec compiles to a star-free DFA through the very same pipeline. Every compiled automaton is differentially checked against a brute-force MSO oracle (quantifiers interpreted literally over positions and the 2^n position-subsets) on every word up to a horizon, plus a ∀≡¬∃¬ duality check and the star-free bridge — a seeded fuzzer verified zero disagreements across 665,000+ checks over random FO and MSO sentences (offline). The tab shows the compiled DFA (DOT/SVG export), the variety verdict with the FO⇒star-free badge, language stats, a truth table (oracle vs automaton), and the per-step CONSTRUCTION TRACE that makes the non-elementary state blow-up visible. PREVIOUS — EQUIVALENCE WITHOUT DETERMINISING: every comparison used to go through a determinised machine (the Compare tab walks the product of the two minimal DFAs, paying the subset construction up front). A new COALGEBRA tab takes the modern road that skips it. Language equivalence is decided by BISIMULATION UP TO CONGRUENCE (the HKC algorithm, Bonchi & Pous, POPL 2013): both ε-NFAs are embedded into one combined powerset and the bisimulation is explored LAZILY, pruning any new pair already implied by the CONGRUENCE CLOSURE (equivalence + closed under union) of what's proved — and the one driver also runs the two weaker classics (naïve Hopcroft–Karp, and up-to-equivalence) so the pay-off is shown, not asserted: on (a|b)*(a(a|b){6}|b(a|b){6}) ≡ (a|b)*(a|b){7} the determinised product has 255 reachable pairs and congruence proves it in 27 (≈9×, and it doubles with every extra repeat). Inclusion & universality go by ANTICHAINS (De Wulf–Doyen–Henzinger–Raskin, CAV 2006) over ⊑-minimal macrostates (q,S) — one existential A-state, the determinised B-subset — yielding the full five-way relation (equal / ⊂ / ⊃ / disjoint / overlap), a concrete counterexample word, and the antichain size against the full product it replaces. Three roads, one verdict, and PROVEN so: a seeded fuzzer decides thousands of random pattern pairs every way and confirms the three HKC modes agree with each other and with the DFA-product comparison, the antichain road rebuilds the same relation, universality matches a DFA oracle, every witness genuinely separates the languages, and HKC never expands more pairs than naïve — verified offline at zero mismatches across 25,000 pairs over 10 seeds. THE STUDIO ALSO LEARNS THE LANGUAGE BACK: every prior road walks the regex you wrote down to an automaton; grammatical inference goes the other way, hiding the pattern behind an oracle and rebuilding the minimal DFA from scratch. ANGLUIN'S L* (active learning) interrogates a 'minimally adequate teacher' — membership queries ('is w in the language?') answered by a walk over the target DFA, and equivalence queries ('is this the right DFA?') answered by the studio's own product-automaton comparison, which hands back the shortest counterexample for free — while maintaining an OBSERVATION TABLE (access strings S × distinguishing experiments E → {0,1}) that it drives to be closed and consistent, reads a hypothesis off, and refines by folding each counterexample's prefixes back into S; at termination the hypothesis is provably the MINIMAL DFA (Myhill–Nerode: one state per distinct row = per residual language), and the studio proves it the house way — the learned machine, minimised, lands byte-for-byte on the very DFA the regex compiles to, with the membership/equivalence query counts reported. RPNI (passive learning, Oncina–García) does it with no questions at all: handed a fixed bag of labelled strings it builds their prefix-tree acceptor and greedily MERGES states lowest-first, accepting any merge whose determinising fold creates no accept/reject clash (no negative example becomes accepted) and rolling back the rest — and because a complete sample of every string up to a sufficient length is characteristic, RPNI provably recovers the exact target, which the panel demonstrates by growing the sample depth until it does. A new Learn tab shows the reconstructed DFA as a pan/zoom graph, the live observation table (+/− cells, S above the one-step boundary S·Σ), the conjecture-and-counterexample trace, the RPNI sample statistics, and a seeded cross-check that learns hundreds of random languages and confirms L* recovers each one's exact minimal DFA (state count and all) and RPNI recovers it from data — verified offline at zero failures across 900+ random patterns. Under that: parse to an AST, then take FOUR independent roads to one automaton — Thompson ε-NFA → subset construction, Brzozowski derivatives straight from the regex, Antimirov partial derivatives that build a tiny ε-free 'equation automaton' (collapsing (a|b|c)* to a single state where Thompson spends ten), and Glushkov's position automaton, ε-free with exactly one state per letter plus a start (the textbook (a|b)*abb → 6 states). All four minimise to the same canonical machine — itself reached two ways, by Moore and by Hopcroft's O(n log n) pass, cross-checked live. NEWEST — a FIFTH road that leaves the core algebra behind for the whole BOOLEAN CLOSURE of the regular languages: intersection (A&B), complement (~A) and difference (A−B). No ε-NFA can express these, so Thompson/Glushkov/Antimirov simply can't — but Brzozowski derivatives extend to them for free (∂c(A&B)=∂cA&∂cB, ∂c(~A)=~∂cA), so the derivative road builds an intersection or complement DIRECTLY into a complete DFA. The password lookahead (?=.*\d)(?=.*[a-z]).{6,} becomes a true regular intersection .*[0-9].*&.*[a-z].*&.{6,} with a finite DFA the lookahead form can never have; 'no abc substring' is ~(.*abc.*); identifiers-minus-keywords is a difference. Every extended pattern is proved the house way — live algebraic-law badges (involution, idempotence, excluded middle A∪~A≡Σ*, non-contradiction A∩~A≡∅), a CLASSICAL CROSS-CHECK that rebuilds the same language with the studio's product/complement automata and proves it equal, and a three-engine differential fuzzer (streaming derivative · derivative DFA · an independent span oracle defined straight from the algebra) over thousands of random Boolean expressions with zero disagreements. Run a string six ways — linear DFA, derivative DFA, streaming derivatives, the partial-derivative NFA, the position automaton, a linear-time Pike VM with captures, and a backtracking VM — and cross-check ten implementations (plus the platform's own RegExp) with a seeded differential fuzzer that already caught a real VM bug. Includes a static ReDoS analyser that proves catastrophic backtracking, synthesises the attack and prescribes the fix, equivalence checking with witnesses, language enumeration, DFA→regex synthesis, and DOT/SVG export. NEWEST of all — an ALGEBRA tab that builds the language's SYNTACTIC MONOID from scratch (the transition monoid of the minimal complete DFA), computes Green's relations R/L/J/H/D and draws the classic EGG-BOX diagram, finds the idempotents, and decides where the language sits by SCHÜTZENBERGER's theorem: aperiodic ⇔ STAR-FREE ⇔ first-order (FO[<]) definable ⇔ the DFA is COUNTER-FREE — cross-checked three independent ways, so (aa)* is exposed as the group ℤ/2 (not star-free, a real mod-2 counter) while a*b* is proved star-free and J-trivial (piecewise testable, Simon). The algebra now climbs a full VARIETY LADDER: trivial ⊂ piecewise-testable (J-trivial, Simon) ⊂ DA / two-variable FO²[<] / unambiguous polynomials (decided by 'every regular element is idempotent') ⊂ star-free / FO[<] / counter-free ⊂ all-regular — and it NAMES the syntactic group up to isomorphism straight off the Cayley table (cyclic ℤ/n, the abelian invariant-factor product ℤ/d₁×…×ℤ/dₖ incl. the Klein four ℤ/2×ℤ/2, dihedral Dₙ incl. S₃≅D₃, quaternion Q₈, A₄/S₄), so a(a|b)* lands in DA-but-not-piecewise, even-a-even-b is named the Klein four-group and (ab)* is the surprise: star-free yet NOT in DA.
